description_en: Queries the information about a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment, including the status and configuration of the experiment, and the status of its trials
description_zh: 获取一个HPO实验的信息，包括状态、配置、以及所属trials的状态等数据
name: GetHpoExperiment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
parameters.name: experiment_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Accessibility.description_en:
The visibility of the experiment in the workspace.

PRIVATE: The experiment is visible only to you and the administrator of the workspace.
PUBLIC: The experiment is public in the workspace
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

Code.description_en: The internal error code. This parameter is returned if an exception occurred
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

ConfigIni.description_en: The content of the trial.ini configuration file

ConfigYml.description_en: The content of the exp.yml configuration file
ConfigYml.example:
assessor:
  classArgs:
    optimize_mode: maximize
    start_step: 1
  name: PAIAssessor
debug: true
experimentName: maxcompute_kmeans_monitor
experimentWorkingDirectory: ../expdir
logLevel: debug
maxTrialNumber: 10
searchSpaceFile: search_space.json
trainingService:
  platform: local
trialCommand: python3 -m hpo_tools.core.utils.run --config=./config.ini
trialConcurrency: 2
tuner:
  classArgs:
    optimize_mode: maximize
  name: TPE

Creator.description_en: The ID of the user who created the experiment

Deleted.description_en: Indicates whether the experiment is deleted

ExperimentId.description_en: The ID of the HPO experiment

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time at which the experiment was created

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time at which the experiment data was last updated
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 实验数据最近更新时间

HpoExperimentConfiguration.description_en: The configuration information of the experiment

JobType.description_en: The type of the experiment. For HPO experiments, the value of this parameter is 1
JobType.description_zh: 实验类型。对于HPO实验，类型值始终是1

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned if an exception occurred
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the POP request

SearchSpace.description_en: The configuration content of the search_space.json file

Status.description_en: The status of the experiment. Valid values:

TrialCount.description_en: The number of trials that are generated by the experiment
TrialCount.description_zh: 实验已经产生的trial的数量

additionalProperties.description_en: The information that contains the status of the trials and the trials in each state
additionalProperties.description_zh: trial 状态和处于各个状态的trial的数量的map

TrialStatus.description_en: The status and number of the trials

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
v1_parameters.name: ExperimentId
